title: Temple of Anahita, Bishapur

groundCutout.basis: Mapped excavated courtyard way 591894141, expanded 1.7 percent into the ruin’s masonry to prevent terrain slivers along the inside edge.

buildingCutout.basis: The authored archaeological ruins replace the generic building form inside mapped temple relation 8338022 only.

terrainReference.basis: Original grade immediately outside the southeast wall. The excavated court floor is below this datum.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap archaeological relation 8338022 identifies the temple. Outer way 591894142 and courtyard way 591894141 independently fix the shell and open court.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap archaeological relation 8338022 maps the outer ruin and the excavated court independently. The renderer opening follows the inner court with a narrow overlap into the modeled stone walls. The surrounding original elevation field is preserved.

note: The March 2025 photo establishes laid stone courses, large rectangular openings, pale lintels, perimeter ledge and an irregular stepped wall top. The approximate excavated floor depth, concealed entrances and outside wall heights are interpreted.
